historian: From its own knowledge describes how protest waves usually arise, develop and die down.
calendar: Assesses calendar effects: holidays, vacations, the school year, typical dates and triggers of protests.
modeler: Proposes a simple model of the dynamics (decay, self-excitation, reversion to the baseline) and fits it to the series.
statistician: Describes the series quantitatively: level, spread, spikes, trend, and the relation between neighbouring weeks.
scenarist: Builds scenarios for the forecast horizon (baseline, spike, decay) and estimates the probability of each.
critic: Checks the hypothesis or the preliminary forecast that the organizer passed in the task and looks for weak points.
